icp: Knowledge-intensive teams publicly using AI across workflows, tools, or internal systems

RingCentral uses ChatGPT Work and Codex across engineering and operational intelligence workflows.
Virgin Atlantic uses ChatGPT Work in customer-journey workflows.
Zapier uses ChatGPT Work in core marketing processes.
HSP GRUPPE uses OpenAI tools to build AI capabilities for tax-advisory work.
Univé is building an AI-ready workforce with OpenAI tools.
Replit uses OpenAI models in software-creation workflows.
Model ML uses OpenAI models to complete finance work more efficiently.
Circles uses OpenAI technology for telecommunications personalization workflows.
avatarin built a continuously available retail agent using OpenAI realtime technology.
Moderna uses ChatGPT Enterprise to extract, draft, cross-reference, and flag issues in Target Product Profile workflows.
